cards.back:
A set of steps that a computer follows to solve a problem.
Bahasa Indonesia: algoritma
Example: The search algorithm sorted the results in a few seconds.
cards.say: algorithm. The search algorithm sorted the results in a few seconds.

cards.back:
Computer systems that can do tasks that usually need human thinking.
Bahasa Indonesia: kecerdasan buatan
Example: Artificial intelligence can translate speech into written text very quickly.
cards.say: artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence can translate speech into written text very quickly.

cards.back:
Using the internet to hurt or frighten someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: perundungan siber
Example: Tell an adult at once if you see cyberbullying online.
cards.say: cyberbullying. Tell an adult at once if you see cyberbullying online.

cards.back:
To change information into a secret code.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengenkripsi
Example: Banks encrypt your details to keep your money safe.
cards.say: encrypt. Banks encrypt your details to keep your money safe.

cards.back:
A person who breaks into computer systems.
Bahasa Indonesia: peretas
Example: A hacker tried to guess the password of the school account.
cards.say: hacker. A hacker tried to guess the password of the school account.

cards.back:
A tool that blocks unwanted access to a computer network.
Bahasa Indonesia: tembok api
Example: The firewall stopped strange messages from entering our network.
cards.say: firewall. The firewall stopped strange messages from entering our network.

cards.back:
Facts and numbers that are stored and used.
Bahasa Indonesia: data
Example: The scientists collected data about rainfall for a whole year.
cards.say: data. The scientists collected data about rainfall for a whole year.

cards.back:
The trail of information you leave when you use the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: jejak digital
Example: Everything you post adds to your digital footprint.
cards.say: digital footprint. Everything you post adds to your digital footprint.

cards.back:
Watching or listening to media over the internet as it arrives.
Bahasa Indonesia: streaming
Example: Streaming a film needs a fast and steady connection.
cards.say: streaming. Streaming a film needs a fast and steady connection.

cards.back:
Existing on a computer rather than in the real world.
Bahasa Indonesia: virtual
Example: We took a virtual tour of the museum from our classroom.
cards.say: virtual. We took a virtual tour of the museum from our classroom.

cards.back:
The part of an app that you see and use.
Bahasa Indonesia: antarmuka
Example: The game has a simple interface that young children can use.
cards.say: interface. The game has a simple interface that young children can use.

cards.back:
To find your way around a website or app.
Bahasa Indonesia: menjelajah
Example: It is easy to navigate the library website with the large buttons.
cards.say: navigate. It is easy to navigate the library website with the large buttons.

cards.back:
Software made to harm a computer or steal data.
Bahasa Indonesia: perangkat lunak berbahaya
Example: Malware can slow down your computer and steal information.
cards.say: malware. Malware can slow down your computer and steal information.

cards.back:
A small flying machine controlled from the ground.
Bahasa Indonesia: drone
Example: The drone carried a camera above the rice fields.
cards.say: drone. The drone carried a camera above the rice fields.

cards.back:
A device that detects light, heat or movement.
Bahasa Indonesia: sensor
Example: A sensor turns on the light when someone walks in.
cards.say: sensor. A sensor turns on the light when someone walks in.

cards.back:
A new idea, method or invention.
Bahasa Indonesia: inovasi
Example: Solar cars are an innovation in how we travel.
cards.say: innovation. Solar cars are an innovation in how we travel.

cards.back:
A person who writes instructions for computers.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemrogram
Example: The programmer fixed a bug that stopped the game starting.
cards.say: programmer. The programmer fixed a bug that stopped the game starting.

cards.back:
A mistake in the instructions that makes software go wrong.
Bahasa Indonesia: galat, bug
Example: A tiny bug made the app close without warning.
cards.say: bug. A tiny bug made the app close without warning.

cards.back:
Keeping files on the internet instead of on your device.
Bahasa Indonesia: penyimpanan awan
Example: I saved my project in cloud storage so I can open it anywhere.
cards.say: cloud storage. I saved my project in cloud storage so I can open it anywhere.

cards.back:
The hours spent looking at a device.
Bahasa Indonesia: waktu layar
Example: Our family limits screen time to one hour on school days.
cards.say: screen time. Our family limits screen time to one hour on school days.

cards.back:
A place of information that you can trust to be correct.
Bahasa Indonesia: sumber tepercaya
Example: Check a reliable source before you share any news.
cards.say: reliable source. Check a reliable source before you share any news.

cards.back:
A message that pops up to tell you something new has happened.
Bahasa Indonesia: notifikasi
Example: A notification told me that my homework had been marked.
cards.say: notification. A notification told me that my homework had been marked.

cards.back:
Using machines to do work without people.
Bahasa Indonesia: otomatisasi
Example: Automation helps factories make thousands of bottles each hour.
cards.say: automation. Automation helps factories make thousands of bottles each hour.
